sources.title: vjepa2-vitl-fpc64-256: Video-to-Video model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview vjepa2-vitl-fpc64-256 is a video understanding model developed by facebook at FAIR/Meta that uses a Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) approach for self-supervised learning on video. The model processes 64 frames at a time and outputs embeddings that represent video content in a learned feature space, enabling applications like video classification, retrieval, and encoding ...
